name: hexamidine diisethionate + salicylic acid
purpose: Purpose Scalp treatment, fights itching and flaking.
uses: Use Controls and relives symptoms of Dandruff, Psoriasis, Folliculitis and Seborrheic Dermatitis.
otcwarn: Do not use If pregnant or breast-feeding ask a health professional before use. This product is not recommended for individuals under 18 years of age. Ask Doctor If pregnant or breast-feeding ask a health professional before use. Stop Use if condition worsens or does not improve after regular use as directed.
